answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 14505 Country: Pakistan Title: Sir, I am impressed with your research work about Islam. May GOD Bless you. Kindly answer my following question. Suupose I am owner of a educational institution. My cast is "A" (Suppose). I do not charge any fee from the students of my cast ("A"). Is this correct action in the light of a last Address of our beloved last Prophet (PBUH). Kindly guide so that I may correct my direction. Thanks! Question: Sir, I am impressed with your research work about Islam. May GOD Bless you. Kindly answer my following question. Suupose I am owner of a educational institution. My cast is "A" (Suppose). I do not charge any fee from the students of my cast ("A"). Is this correct action in the light of a last Address of our beloved last Prophet (PBUH). Kindly guide so that I may correct my direction. Thanks! Answer ID: 14505 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1068/870=L/1430) When you are the owner of the institution, you have right to exempt the students of your caste to pay fees. However, if you grant the exemption to the students on the ground of poverty and neediness, it will be better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
